plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-10-02 from the official Case Western Reserve University General Bulletin (2026-27) 'Neuroscience' BS 'Sample Plan of Study' grid (https://bulletin.case.edu/arts-sciences/biology/neuroscience-bs/). Footnotes: 'a': Unified General Education Requirement. 'b': BIOL 358 Animal Behavior may be counted as either a Neurobiology Core Course or an Ecology/Evolution Course, but not both. 'c': BIOL 375 can satisfy the Neurobiology Core requirement, or the Ecology/Evolutionary Biology Core requirement, but not both. 'd': At least one course must be a non-BIOL course. 'e': 3 credit hours of BIOL 388 (or NEUR 388) and 3 credit hours of BIOL 388S (or NEUR 388S) are required to fulfill the Undergraduate Research Requirement for the Neuroscience BS. 'or' rows are modeled per convention with choice:true, first option as code, and all options in options[]. Rows combining lecture+lab (e.g. 'EBME 306 & EBME 356') are kept as one combined course with the official combined credit total. Unlabeled credit slots are elective choice placeholders. Prerequisites are not printed in the sample plan, so prereq arrays are empty; prerequisites live in the bulletin's course descriptions.
